Package com.example.eventlottery.domain

Class EntrantCategorizationTest

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlottery.domain.EntrantCategorizationTest
public class EntrantCategorizationTest extends Object
Unit tests for entrant categorization by WaitStatus. Validates the logic used by OrganizerEventDetailFragment to sort entrants into Waiting, Invited, Enrolled, and Cancelled sections. User stories tested: - US 02.06.01: View a list of all chosen (invited) entrants - US 02.06.02: View a list of all cancelled entrants - US 02.06.03: View a final list of entrants who enrolled (accepted)
Version:
1.0
Author:
Fawaz Mansoor

    void
    testAcceptFromWaitingThrowsException()
    Verifies that attempting to accept an invitation when an entrant has WAITING status (not INVITED) throws IllegalStateException.
    void
    testAcceptTransitionMovesFromInvitedToEnrolled()
    Verifies that accepting an invitation transitions an entrant from INVITED status to ACCEPTED (enrolled) status.
    void
    testAllEntrantsAreCategorized()
    Verifies that summing all categorized sections (waiting, invited, enrolled, cancelled) equals the total number of entrants.
    void
    testCancelledSectionShowsCancelledAndDeclined()
    Verifies that filtering for CANCELLED and DECLINED statuses returns all entrants who declined or were cancelled.
    void
    testDeclineFromWaitingThrowsException()
    Verifies that attempting to decline an invitation when an entrant has WAITING status (not INVITED) throws IllegalStateException.
    void

    Verifies that declining an invitation transitions an entrant from INVITED status to DECLINED status.
